scope_of_work: Remove partitions shown dashed complete - metal stud and GWB, approx. 700 LF measured (Plan Note 1)
Remove portion of existing wall to match adjacent header height, approx. 7'-3" AFF (Plan Note 2)
Remove existing partial height walls complete (Plan Note 3)
Remove existing metal studs and GWB complete (Plan Note 4)
Remove doors and frames complete (Plan Note 5)
Remove existing storefront doors, transom and threshold complete (Plan Note 6)
Remove abandoned plumbing rough-in stubs at removed walls - capping by plumber (Plan Note 7)
Remove existing overhead door complete (Plan Note 11)
Remove existing window film at storefront glazing (Plan Note 14)
Remove hanging wire, bulkhead/soffit framing and debris at deck level (no ACT ceiling exists per site photos) (FP-101 Note 4; Mech Note K3)
Remove loose lighting whips and boxes; electrical removal limited to disconnect and removal back to nearest junction box (E-2 General Note)
Remove existing abandoned electrical devices, conduit and wiring not shown to remain, back to nearest junction box (E-1 / E-3 General Note)
Scrape remaining adhesive residue at back-of-house rooms (no floor finish exists per site photos) (CS1 Scope of Work; A4 Finish Schedule)
Daily clean-up, C&D haul-off and leave space broom clean (Gen. Demo Notes 2, 3, 16)
exclusions: Fire sprinkler demolition and modifications (FP-101) - by fire protection contractor
Electrical panels, transformer, disconnects and make-safe (Plan Note 8) - by electrician
Plumbing disconnect, cap and below-slab work (Plan Note 7; P-1) - by plumber
RTUs, rigid ductwork, curbs, roofing, refrigerant recovery (Mech Note K3) - see Alternate 5
Sawcutting/trenching, concrete, mastic removal and grinding - see Alternates
Previous tenant exterior signage - see Alternate 4
All patching, repair, infill and prep for new finishes (Gen. Demo Note 13; New Work Note 14)
Dust barriers and temporary partitions (Gen. Demo Note 10)
Shoring limited to non-load-bearing; load-bearing shoring, design and stamped drawings excluded (Gen. Demo Note 15)
Items to remain: storefront system and glazing, existing soffit, canopy, demising walls, sprinkler riser, electrical service
Night/weekend work; bid based on normal daytime hours, unrestricted dumpster access

alternates.label: Sawcut and remove slab for plumbing trench, remove only - infill by others (Plan Note 9; P-1 K4)
